title: Sycophancy-to-Deception Causal Pathway: Does Sycophancy Training Enable Deception?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If sycophancy training increases deceptive capability, it reframes sycophancy from a helpfulness problem to a fundamental safety risk. Clear chain: sycophancy -> deception -> strengthened case for anti-sycophancy interventions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing a sycophancy-inducing preference dataset and running RLHF-style training. Then evaluating on deception benchmarks. The RLHF training component is the main blocker for beginners, as in gen-1844.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single training run plus evaluation on deception benchmarks. If using DPO instead of PPO, the training is simpler. Clear deliverable: deception score comparison between sycophancy-trained and control models. Manageable if DPO is used.
